defect: The fix replaces the member dpi_scale with the global g_dpi_scale so that the shared UI code sees the Blackberry DPI scale.
reason: The previous Blackberry frontend already kept the scale in a local dpi_scale and never set g_dpi_scale, so the missing global assignment predates this change.

defect: The fix renames dpi_scale to g_dpi_scale in the touch handlers so the global DPI scale is set and used.
reason: The new NativeTouch lines multiply by the same scale as the pre-existing pointer code; the real issue (g_dpi_scale never assigned) is in startDisplays and existed before this change.

defect: The fix removes the temporary suppression of a validation-layer false positive once the Vulkan SDK bug was fixed.
reason: Removing an obsolete workaround is cleanup, not the repair of a defect in the change.

defect: The fix enables sincosf on Android as well after the NDK bug was fixed.
reason: This extends an optimization to another platform; the Android exclusion was a deliberate workaround, not a defect.

defect: GetCharInfo calls memset(charInfo, 0, sizeof(charInfo)), clearing only pointer-size bytes, so the rest of PGFCharInfo (e.g. pad) is left uninitialized.
reason: The fix changes it to sizeof(*charInfo), repairing a line this change added; its other edits are warning cleanups.

defect: The fix stops reusing drawPixelsTex_ across MakePixelTexture calls (a new texture per upload) and binds attribute semantics for the draw2d program.
reason: The reuse logic predates this WIP change and became wrong only once later commits (46e1fbb, 8a1e734) made the uploads deferred through TextureImage, which this change did not add.

defect: The slider uses the translation key 'Refresh Interval' while the same commit renamed the lang ini keys to 'Refresh interval', so the label is never translated.
reason: The fix corrects the key in the line this change added; the mismatch is visible only against the lang ini files.

defect: axis() maps a value of 0 to the positive direction only, so a digital axis (HAT or d-pad) returning from negative to 0 never releases the negative-direction key, which sticks.
reason: The fix processes both directions when the value is 0, repairing logic this change introduced.

defect: The fix redesigns the credits screen layout for landscape, putting the scroller between the two button columns.
reason: With CanScroll false the change passes root_ to CreateDialogViews and keeps the old layout, so the landscape fix is a redesign, not the repair of a regression from this change.

defect: The fix wraps the 'Stereo display shader' label in gr->T() so it can be translated.
reason: The untranslated literal existed in the graphics settings code before; this change only moved it to the developer tools screen.

defect: Changing the guard from PPSSPP_ARCH(ARM) to PPSSPP_ARCH(ARM_NEON) also enables it on ARM64, where ARM_NEON is defined but the 32-bit NEON hash and unswizzle functions are not built, breaking the ARM64 Android build.
reason: The fix adds !PPSSPP_ARCH(ARM64) to the line this change edited; seeing it requires ppsspp_config.h.

defect: The fix drops GL_STENCIL_BUFFER_BIT from the no-framebuffer clear until a stencil buffer exists.
reason: Per the GL and GLES specs clearing an absent buffer has no effect, so the added bit was harmless and its removal is precautionary.

defect: The fix removes the HasSaveInSlot guard so LoadSlot reports an error for an empty slot.
reason: The guard that suppressed the error message predates this change, which only added the gamePath_ argument.

defect: The fix rounds the decode buffer height up to a multiple of 4 so DXT block decoding does not overflow mapData.
reason: The pre-change buffer new u32[w * h] and the tmpTexBufRearrange resize already used the unrounded height, so the overflow predates this change.

defect: For PSP_MODE_AT_3 the low-level decode still builds data_buf from the uninitialized at3plusHeader and copies filesize - headersize (about 16 MB) from guest memory, crashing.
reason: The fix moves the buffer setup into the ATRAC3+ branch, repairing code this change added.

defect: The fix moves LimitedWaitable into Common/Thread/Waitable.h so the unit test can use it.
reason: For this file the fix is a pure move of the class, a refactor without behaviour change.

defect: The fix reworks the new stress test to wait on a LimitedWaitable per task and cuts the iterations, which also removes the racy counter check right after the barrier.
reason: The fix is a test change made to reproduce a crash, not a repair of product code.

defect: The fix maps GE_PRIM_KEEP_PREVIOUS with an invalid previous prim to POINTS and stores the prim as s8, avoiding the NFSU crash.
reason: Before this change KEEP_PREVIOUS after a Flush already resolved to GE_PRIM_INVALID and was stored in a u8, so the crash path predates it.

defect: The fix ORs 0x04000000 into the address passed to DrawPixels.
reason: addr reaches DrawPixels only when it equals DisplayFramebufAddr(), which already includes 0x04000000, so the fix is defensive and repairs no actual fault.

defect: The switch over sys_info.subsystem uses case WINDOWSYSTEM_DISPLAY (a PPSSPP enum equal to 2) instead of SDL_SYSWM_KMSDRM, duplicating SDL_SYSWM_X11 and failing to compile when VK_USE_PLATFORM_DISPLAY_KHR is defined.
reason: The fix replaces the wrong enum in the case label this change added.

defect: The new not-playing checks return ERROR_PSMF_NOT_INITIALIZED (and also reject the ERROR status) where the PSP returns ERROR_PSMFPLAYER_INVALID_STATUS for status below PLAYING.
reason: The fix changes the error code and condition of the check this change added; the correct code is known only from hardware behaviour.

defect: Using mainwindow.h and MainWindow whenever Q_WS_X11 is defined also hits Harmattan/MeeGo (X11 with GLES2), where the desktop Qt main window is not available, breaking that build.
reason: The fix adds && !defined(USING_GLES2) to both guards this change added.

defect: The fix changes the local variableCount from u32_le to u32.
reason: The u32_le type of this local predates the change, which only altered its initializer, and a little-endian wrapper on a local is not a functional bug.

defect: The fix adds a (WaitType)(u32) cast when reading nt.waitType.
reason: At this change nt.waitType was a plain WaitType; the cast became necessary only after a later commit made it WaitType_le.

defect: sceKernelCancelSema resets the count to initCount only for newCount == -1, so other negative values set a negative current count.
reason: The fix uses newCount < 0 in the line this change added, matching PSP behaviour shown by tests.

defect: The fix makes TextView measure multi-line text and clip oversized text, and draws the shadow without the offset.
reason: The crash was in draw_text.cpp; the view.cpp edits are behaviour changes, not repairs of a defect this change added.

defect: The new check axis.deviceId < DEVICE_ID_COUNT lets negative IDs such as DEVICE_ID_ANY (-1) through, writing deviceTimestamps_[-1], and the array has a magic size of 42.
reason: The fix makes the comparison unsigned and sizes the array by DEVICE_ID_COUNT, repairing lines this change added, though the author notes the case is unlikely in practice.

defect: The fix re-enables the vmmul transpose optimization and writes S back before transposing it.
reason: The missing write-back of S predates this change, which only disabled the optimization as a workaround.

defect: Including GLES3/gl3.h and gl3ext.h on Blackberry drops the NVIDIA extension declarations from GLES2/gl2ext.h that the code uses, causing build errors on Blackberry.
reason: The fix reverts the Blackberry header branch this change added.

defect: The fix renames the KEY_ANALOG_FAKE_* references to KEY_ANALOG_*.
reason: At this change KeyMap.h defined KEY_ANALOG_FAKE_*; the dangling names came from the later header rename in f63ea38.

defect: Rewind now uses zip_fseek, which does not work on compressed zip entries (its result is ignored), so texture packs in compressed zips are read from the wrong position.
reason: The fix restores close-and-reopen in Rewind, replacing the line this change added; the limitation lies in libzip.

defect: The fix removes a stray trailing quote character from the Core/Reporting.h include line.
reason: The extra token only produces preprocessor warnings, so this is a typo cleanup rather than a functional or build defect.

defect: RunPauseAction notifies actionWait even for PAUSE_CONTINUE, so an early or spurious wake-up in PauseWithMessage releases SetPauseAction before the requested action ran, breaking the debugger (seen on 32-bit).
reason: The fix returns without notifying in the PAUSE_CONTINUE case of the function this change added.

defect: The fix silences a 32-bit constant truncation warning by excluding the probing block on Android and adding ULL.
reason: The probing block is not used on Android; the fix addresses a compiler warning, not a functional or build failure.

defect: The fix removes a stale comment on the callback call.
reason: Comment-only change.

defect: DrawActiveTexture takes the glDrawTextureNV fast path whenever a texture is passed, ignoring the program argument, so on Tegra the FXAA pass and output-resolution post shaders are skipped.
reason: The fix adds && !program to the fast-path condition this change moved into DrawActiveTexture.

defect: madd and maddu map LO/HI with the default avoidLoad of MapDirtyDirtyInIn, so LO/HI are mapped MAP_NOINIT and SMLAL/UMLAL accumulate into stale registers.
reason: The fix passes avoidLoad=false for the two cases this change added; seeing it needs the ArmRegCache semantics.

defect: The new avoidLoad logic is inverted for avoidLoad=false: rd is then always mapped MAP_NOINIT, so a destination that must be loaded is not.
reason: The fix rewrites the condition as load = !avoidLoad || overlap in the MapDirtyIn/MapDirtyInIn code this change added.

defect: The fix changes the loop index from int to size_t.
reason: This only silences a signed/unsigned comparison warning.

defect: The fix changes furthestBranch >= addr to > addr so a branch to the jr ra still ends the function.
reason: This change only reformatted that code; the comparison predates it.
